demo_chips: How much does a panel upgrade cost?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Three Rivers Electric at 651-418-1476 or info@3riverselectricmn.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: How much does a whole-home generator cost installed?
faqs.a: As a rough range, expect $7,000-$18,000 installed for a typical residential whole-home or essential-circuit system, with higher-load homes (24-26kW) running higher.

faqs.q: How long does a panel upgrade take?
faqs.a: A typical 100A or 150A to 200A swap is 6-8 hours of on-site work. From saying yes to a signed permit in your file is usually 2-4 weeks.
Yes - Xcel Energy offers a rebate of up to $1,500 on qualifying panel upgrades, and we file it for you.

pricing.summary: Most 200-amp panel and service upgrades in the Twin Cities run $7,700 to $9,500 installed (100-amp like-for-like starts around $7,700, and a full service replacement can run up to $12,500). A whole-home surge protector is $527 installed, Level 2 EV charger installation runs $800-$2,500, and whole-home generators run roughly $7,000-$18,000 installed. Xcel Energy rebates of up to $1,500 may apply to a qualifying upgrade - and we file the rebate for you.
